name: B10-0181/2024 (The Left) – Georgia's worsening democratic crisis following the recent parliamentary elections and alleged electoral fraud
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Georgia’s worsening democratic crisis following the recent parliamentary elections and alleged electoral fraud
part_text:
The European Parliament gives its opinion on Georgia's October 2024 elections. It accepts the results and asks all sides to respect them, but says the vote took place in a tense and unfair environment. It asks the new Georgian government to fix remaining election recommendations. It also criticises two new Georgian laws, one on "foreign influence" and one on "family values", saying they threaten civil society, media freedom and LGBTQ+ people. It urges dialogue between Georgia and the EU.

- The text is an opinion; no law changes. It calls on Georgia's government to act.
- It affects Georgia's government, civil society, media and LGBTQ+ people.
- Next: the EU and Georgia are urged to keep talking; the resolution goes to EU bodies and Georgia.
